standard.summary: 读取现有 LoRA 文件的训练参数元数据（network_dim、alpha 等）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Reads the training parameter metadata (network_dim, alpha and so on) from an existing LoRA file.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 读取现有 LoRA 文件的训练参数元数据（network_dim、alpha、学习率、分辨率等），用于参考或复现训练配置。仅读取文件头部，不加载权重。

advanced_en.principle: Reads the training-parameter metadata of an existing LoRA file (network_dim, alpha, learning rate, resolution, etc.) for reference or reproducing a training config. Reads only the file header, never loads weights.
